about_the_game:
Flower Dungeon DEMO Version !

<Story>

You’ve become a baron of Solvania!

To protect your chaotic and disordered domain, you must recruit beautiful heroes and eliminate countless threats.

Powerful enemies and unexpected events await you deep within the dungeons.

Use your strategy and choices to uncover and defeat the mysterious force lurking in the depths.

<Control beautiful and charming heroes!>

Take command of stunning heroes, each with their own unique personalities and abilities, and conquer the dungeon through their strengths!

<Explore uniquely crafted pixel-art dungeons!>

Delve into retro-style pixel-art dungeons full of secrets and hidden paths.

Every run presents new challenges with procedurally generated dungeon layouts.

Understand each hero’s unique abilities to develop them in the most effective way possible!

<Over 100 events, immersive lore entries, and mysterious beings to discover!>

Encounter over 100 dynamic events, where outcomes can be either beneficial or disastrous based on your choices.

Uncover lore-filled journals and come face-to-face with mysterious entities that reveal the secrets of the dungeon and its world.

<Face off against dangerously charming enemies!>

Deep within the dungeon, powerful and alluring foes await your challenge.

Ten uniquely designed stage bosses each bring powerful abilities—and captivating beauty.

Defeat them to claim powerful gear and further your conquest!

<Strategic growth through faith, traits, talents, gear, companions, and more!>
Your hero grows in many ways: leveling up, developing faith, unlocking traits and talents, equipping powerful items, and forging bonds with companions.
Your strategy determines how efficiently your hero evolves.
Enjoy the freedom of building unique playstyles—adding depth to every roguelite adventure.

Experience Flower Dungeon now—a roguelite journey where strategy, action, and subculture charm come together in one unforgettable adventure!
